LESSON: WRITING 8.4.1 SPELLING

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade three
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 8
Topic 8.4: Writing 8.4.1 Spelling
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 8.4.1 Spelling, part of Strand 8 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade three ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: What is the importance of correct spelling?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. Spell the words with the target letter-sound combinations (-ft, -ct, -lt, -rd). Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative and augmentative modes of communication.

2. Make words related to the theme from jumbled letters, with peers.

3. Write 4-7 letter words from a dictation. Learners with speech or manipulation difficulties can type or use adapted writing tools. .

4. Copy words legibly and correctly. Learners with manipulation difficulties could use adapted writing tools and materials, alternative functional parts of the body or use assistive technology.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. Spell the words with the target letter-sound combinations (-ft, -ct, -lt, -rd). Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative and augmentative modes of communication.
2. Make words related to the theme from jumbled letters, with peers.
3. Write 4-7 letter words from a dictation. Learners with speech or manipulation difficulties can type or use adapted writing tools. .
4. Copy words legibly and correctly. Learners with manipulation difficulties could use adapted writing tools and materials, alternative functional parts of the body or use assistive technology.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 8.4.1 Spelling together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication: The learner’s ability to write clearly and correctly is enhanced as they spell words correctly.

Values:
Unity: Cooperation is enhanced as the learner actively takes part in group activities with peers.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skills (Self-esteem): The learner acquires high level of self-esteem as they spell words correctly.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner is able to link the concept of correct spelling of words in learning of similar concepts in Kiswahili and Indigenous

Language Activities.
